title: cmd/tk command tests fail under heavy machine load
description:
Seen once during this epic: TestApproveCommand, TestRejectCommand and TestUpdateVerdictFlag all failed with "expected approve exit 0, got 2" during a full go test ./... run, while a cloud run, two pollers and a stream of API fetches were saturating the machine. The same tree passed on origin/main alone, on the epic branch before the merge, on the single test in isolation, on the cmd/tk package alone, and on a full re-run once the machine was quiet.

Exit 2 rather than an assertion failure suggests the spawned binary was killed or timed out rather than misbehaving, so the likely cause is a deadline that is generous on an idle machine and not on a loaded one. Find the deadline and either make it robust or make the failure say "timed out" instead of reporting an exit code that reads like a usage error — the current message sent me looking for a merge regression that did not exist.

Do not fix this by lengthening a sleep. It matters because CI runners are loaded by definition, and this class already bit this repo once (the herdr AfterList ordering race in .tick/config.md).
